findings.message: Detected 2 matching img entries with the same source/start/duration.
findings.fixHint: Avoid duplicated media nodes that can be discovered twice during compilation.

findings.message: Font family used without @font-face declaration: impact. These are not in the auto-resolved font list, so the renderer cannot supply them automatically. Text will fall back to a generic font, producing incorrect typography in the video.
findings.fixHint: Add @font-face { font-family: '...'; src: url('capture/assets/fonts/...woff2'); } for each font family, pointing to the captured .woff2 files. For an OS-bundled system font (e.g. Hiragino Sans, Microsoft YaHei) that has no downloadable file, use src: local('Exact Font Name') instead. The declaration alone satisfies this check without needing a font file.

findings.message: <div id="scene-hook"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div>. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <div id="scene-hook"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.
